text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eeek! It's Super Creek! Mommy, I'm<n>scared!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Grrrr! I'll eat you up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eeeeep!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's notoriety grows to<n>rival Oguri Cap's
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling, Super Creek?<n>What's your
outlook for the Arima<n>Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, both Tamtam and Oguri are<n>trying their best,
but they've still got a<n>ways to go. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much they struggle,<n>they won't win.
Hehehe, the world is<n>mine. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In all seriousness, how do you see<n>the middle and
long-distance<n>Nakayama races playing out?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, don't things seem strange to<n>you lately?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing my part to play the villain,<n>but
everyone's so indifferent.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Garoto A
text_block_list.text: Look, it's Creek! Over there! See?

text_block_list.name: Garoto B
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, you're right! She's so fast and<n>strong!
Creeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: See what I mean?
choice_data_list: Maybe they're starting to see you differently.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But why?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, she was simply<n>Oguri Cap's rival.
But as she gets<n>more exposure...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps people, both fans and<n>non-fans alike, are
starting to see<n>Super Creek for who she really is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, how complicated. I don't mind<n>being the
villain though. It's kind of<n>fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy as long as everyone is<n>enjoying
themselves.
choice_data_list: Maybe people want to see you in a different role.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A different role? You mean as<n>something other than
a villain?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'm not sure if I can just<n>switch things up
on the fly.
choice_data_list:
I believe you already have another character up
your sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Another character? By that, do you<n>mean...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has begun to realize that<n>Super Creek
doesn't have to act like<n>a super athlete—because
she already<n>is one.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The winds of change have started<n>howling in the
lead-up to the<n>end-of-year showdown.
